Safety and evidence

Breast Fillers, Sculptra and Biostimulators: Important Safety Questions

Explain product-specific indications and why facial aesthetic treatments cannot automatically be considered suitable for breast injections.

Home/Insights/Breast Fillers, Sculptra and Biostimulators: Important Safety Questions

Many injectable products are approved for specific facial indications. That approval does not extend to the breast.

Approval is specific

An approval for one indication does not imply suitability for another. Facial approval does not establish that a product is safe or appropriate for injection into the breast.

The breast is different

The breast is a different anatomical site with different considerations, and complications can be more difficult to manage. This is why regulators advise against using fillers to increase breast size.

Product-specific questions

Ask for the exact product, its approved indications, whether breast use is authorised in your jurisdiction, and how complications would be managed.

Editorial disclaimer

This article is educational and does not provide a personal diagnosis or treatment recommendation. It is an editorial draft: an author and a suitably qualified clinical reviewer will be credited only once the article has actually been authored and reviewed.
